dct_description_sm: Abstract: This datalayer contains polygon boundaries and minimal codes for significant landslide hazard areas for King County, Washington. It is derived from the coverage SLIDE, a working (maintenance) copy of the Sensitive Areas Ordinance GIS data set SLIDESAO. As of October 1997, the content of the two coverages is the same.
Purpose: This datalayer is suitable for general reference, medium to small scale map displays, and generalized analyses.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
